title: build: Cargo.lock stale after crate-jmap unpin
description: 13c7857 (build: track crate-jmap main, drop rev pin) changed Cargo.toml but not Cargo.lock, which still pins jmap-chat-types 0.2.0 at crate-jmap rev b8b6f25. Verified 2026-10-21 on main 4eb5520: 'cargo metadata --locked --offline' exits 101 ('cannot update the lock file ... --locked was passed'). A plain build re-resolves crate-jmap main (0.2.0 -> 0.3.0, adds jmap-did-types), so --locked builds/CI likely fail. Fix: cargo update -p for the crate-jmap crates, run the full build-and-test gate, commit Cargo.lock.
